officialSources.observation: Official Bihar Government/NIC BhuNaksha viewer. The public page exposes State, District, Sub Div, Circle, Mauza, Survey Type, Map Instance and Sheet No selectors and describes the system as cadastral mapping software. The inspected current JavaScript configured public REST and WMS routes.

Official Madhubani district page says land-record computerization services, including record of rights and online mutation, are provided through the respective circle offices and links to Bihar's land-record route. This is local service-custodian evidence, not a parcel geometry API.

Official Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms Department page links Bhu-Naksha, online revenue records, online Jamabandi and related land services. General departmental service evidence does not itself prove citywide open parcel geometry.
Official Directorate of Land Records and Survey service page lists Online Map and related survey/map services. It is agency/service evidence rather than an anonymous parcel feature response.

requests.outcome: Fetched the current public viewer HTML. It loaded assets/misc/config.js and index.js; the configuration used same-host public REST routes and WMS.
Current configuration returned SERVICE_PATH and COMMON_SERVER_PATH as same-host relative routes; no credentials or private tokens were present.
Returned 7 viewer levels for Bihar (state code 10).

Returned the Madhubani district/subdivision selection context, including Sadar Madhubani and its circle options; the response also exposed survey types and map-instance choices. Full unchanged response is in ignored scratch evidence under tmp/valhalla-parcel-research/madhubani/sadar-levels.json.

Returned the Rajnagar circle village list; one observed native village code/name was 0453 / Madhubani Tol(48). This is a source selection identity, not a city parcel identity. Other Sadar circles were also enumerated in scratch requests.
No usable response body or extent was returned for the bounded anonymous probe. This was recorded as an unusable/partial viewer response, not as evidence of cadastral absence.
Anonymous WMS capabilities request returned server error. No retry escalation, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, private token, or TLS exception was used.

registryBasis: Bihar's official BhuNaksha viewer and the official Madhubani district land-record service page establish an official state/local land-record and cadastral-map service route. A city-bounded anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was not verified.
